auto_renew.description: Whether the license config should be auto renewed when it reaches the end date.
auto_renew.rationale: Controls whether the license auto-renews at its end date. This is a licensing/financial governance choice and does not map to a security archetype; a platform security policy should not dictate renewal behaviour.

free_trial.description: Whether the license config is for free trial.
free_trial.rationale: Indicates whether the license config is a free trial. This is a licensing/billing attribute, not a security control, so constraining it would not improve security.

license_config_id.description: The unique id of the license config.
license_config_id.rationale: Identifier for the license config resource. We do not constrain resource identifiers, so it is not a policy target.

license_count.rationale: Number of licenses provisioned in the license config. This is a licensing/cost quantity, not a security control, so constraining it would not improve security.

location.description:
The geographic location where the data store should reside. The value can
only be one of "global", "us" and "eu".
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Project the resource belongs to. This is an identifier/reference and is not a security policy target.

subscription_term.rationale: Specifies the license subscription duration. This is a licensing/billing term, not a security control, so constraining it would not improve security.

subscription_tier.description: Subscription tier information for the license config. Possible values: ["SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_UNSPECIFIED", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_SEARCH", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_SEARCH_AND_ASSISTANT", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_NOTEBOOK_LM", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_FRONTLINE_WORKER", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_AGENTSPACE_STARTER", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_AGENTSPACE_BUSINESS", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_ENTERPRISE", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_EDU", "SUBSCRIPTION_TIER_EDU_PRO"]
subscription_tier.rationale: Selects the license subscription tier (search, assistant, notebook, etc.). These tiers reflect product feature/billing levels rather than a tier that gates a specific security feature, so it is a financial/functional choice, not a security policy target.

end_date.day.description: Day of a month. Must be from 1 to 31 and valid for the year and month, or 0 to specify a year by itself or a year and month where the day isn't significant.

end_date.month.description: Month of a year. Must be from 1 to 12, or 0 to specify a year without a month and day.

end_date.year.description: Year of the date. Must be from 1 to 9999, or 0 to specify a date without a year.

start_date.day.description: Day of a month. Must be from 1 to 31 and valid for the year and month, or 0 to specify a year by itself or a year and month where the day isn't significant.

start_date.month.description: Month of a year. Must be from 1 to 12, or 0 to specify a year without a month and day.

start_date.year.description: Year of the date. Must be from 1 to 9999, or 0 to specify a date without a year.
